sb.name: Szikzith
sb.senses: blindsight 10 ft., darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 13

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.desc: Szikzith can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Web Sense
traits.desc: While in contact with a web, Szikzith knows the exact location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

traits.name: Web Walker
traits.desc: Szikzith ignores movement restrictions caused by webbing.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage, and the target must make a DC 11 Constitution saving throw, taking 7 (2d6) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If the poison damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, the target is stable but poisoned for 1 hour, even after regaining hit points, and is paralyzed while poisoned in this way.
